title: Since I'm hearing about others' experiences with water/water parks/pools etc. in their version of ye olde Mallworld, I propose:

classification.question_topic: Whether the liminal pool/waterpark spaces shown in the game “Pools” resonate with others’ Mallworld water/pool experiences

meta.author_theory: Mentions the game world feels like Mallworld and 'felt like I'd been there before'; suggests it could be created based on someone's dream.

locations.location_name: Long tiled corridor flooded with water (game screenshot)

qualities.raw_description: White tiled corridor-like space filled with water; multiple small square windows along the walls; bright rectangular ceiling light; several colorful pool floats/rings (yellow, purple, orange, blue) drifting; foggy/hazy distance.

locations.location_name: Indoor pool room with red spiral slide (game screenshot)

qualities.raw_description: White tiled room with a pool; metal pool ladder in foreground; large red spiral tube slide structure around a central column; oval/vertical bright wall lights; water reflecting red slide.
White tiled room with large archway leading into a dark circular tunnel; water level up to mid-wall; side alcove with a vase/plant-like object; dark opening suggests deeper passage.

locations.location_name: Indoor pool lane with narrow central channel (game screenshot)

qualities.raw_description: Large white tiled hall; shallow water along the left side with repeated wall recesses/columns; a narrow blue-tiled channel running down the center like a lane; right side has a walkway with metal handrail; far end has two tall glowing oval door/window openings.

connections.qualities: Game described as walking around 'mostly-if not completely empty' liminal spaces; architecture/physics 'bizarre/nonsensical'.
Arched opening leading into a dark circular tunnel over/through water (as shown in screenshot).

interactions.description: Author observes/depicts liminal pool/water spaces from the game 'Pools' and notes the spaces feel 'off' and 'dangerous despite it's apparent lack of dangerous things'.
Observation of an empty indoor pool room with a large red spiral slide and bright wall lights; no people present.
Observation of a large arched opening into a dark tunnel from a tiled pool room; water partially fills the space.
Observation of a long tiled hall with water along one side and a narrow blue-tiled channel; far end has two tall glowing openings; space appears empty and quiet.

extraction.extraction_notes: Post is not a dream report; it references a videogame and includes screenshots. Extracted phenomenological qualities from the text description ('eery-feeling', empty, liminal, 'off', bizarre architecture/physics) and from visible features in the screenshots (tiled pool spaces, water level, lighting, slide, tunnel). No explicit navigation sequence or confirmed connectivity between screenshots is provided; connections are recorded as implied by depicted passages (hallway/tunnel) rather than stated travel.
